title: Netflix is testing an AI Discover tab on TVs in the United States
friendlyTitle: Netflix is testing an AI Discover tab on TVs in the United States
summary: On 3 November, Netflix said a small group of members in the United States, using Netflix in English on supported TVs, will see a Discover tab. The first experiment is themes with clips: how you want to feel, who is watching, or how much time you have. Netflix's examples include Something Light, Scare Me, Family Movie Night, and Quick Watches. Each title has a Tune Your Recommendations button next to Play and My List, to keep a suggestion or stop one from returning. Netflix calls the tab a test kitchen. Some experiments may later move into the main app. If you have it, the button is in the top bar, with a red gem and a New label. More people get it over the coming weeks.

whyItMatters: This is not a new chatbot on your phone. It is a TV tab, in English, in the United States, for a small group. The useful control is the one that tells Netflix not to suggest a title again. If the tab is not in your top bar, you are not in the test yet.
